segments: Your product feed is telling A I agents things that aren't true.
One call. You post one feed item, exactly as it sits in your catalogue.
It caught four faults. Price wasn't a number. Currency wasn't an I S O code. The G T I N failed its check digit. Availability wasn't a schema dot org value.
Then look at the schema it emitted. Those four fields are simply absent. It reports what's missing — it never fills the gap with a guess.
Fix the item, call again, and the offer block appears. Price, currency, availability.
Three cents a call. Vela Commerce.
